QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #7
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol heard that I have reached Level 2 of the Maker skill, and asked if I could make a pair of gloves for him. I really don't understand how someone who's asking for a favor keeps making rude requests!\n\n#i4001180# #t4001180# #b#c4001180# / 1
QuestInfo.2: Moren's coworker Keol asked if I could make a pair of gloves for him. I managed to make one for him, but he told me he can't even wear those outside. Keol really needs to go to the charm school.

0.0: Moren told me that you have reached Level 2 of the Maker skill. This is unbelievable. I can't believe you're already up there, since I can still see numerous flaws in your products. I wonder how low the bar was when Moren saw you.
0.1: Anyhow, this time, I'd like to make a personal request of an item. Can I honestly expect better results than that hideous #t4001174# you made last time? I mean, you leveled up and all... right?

yes.0: I want you to make #b#t4001180##k. My gloves are worn out with holes all over them, so I need a new pair. This will be a good indicator of how much you have improved over the past few days.

no.0: For the life of me I cannot figure out what Moren sees in you when he divulges his item-producing knowledge on you. All I see is someone who has no confidence whatsoever.

1.0: Let's see. I'm very picky on the quality side of the items. Hmmm... just as I expected, this isn't up to par with my standard. I can tell you tried, but... it's not good enough in my eyes. But what can I do...

item.0: Did you make the #b#t4001180##k that I asked you to make? How come I am not hearing anything from you about this?

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
